# Flex-Direction: Column

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Flex-Direction: Column

You can arrange the items vertically using flex-direction: column.

Example

```html
1<div class="container">
2    <div class="box box1">First Item</div>
3    <div class="box box2">Second Item</div>
4    <div class="box box3">Third Item</div>
5</div>
```

```css
1.container {
2    display: flex;
3    gap: 10px;
4    flex-direction: column;
5}
```
